Name: Seasonal Pet Bowls - Replacement
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[center][b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=6]KhaStark Seasonal Pet Bowls[/size][/font][/b]
[left][/left]
[/center]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Give your pets a cozy little spot of their own![/i][/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]KhaStark Seasonal Pet Bowls replaces the three vanilla pet bowl appearances with nine colorful seasonal designs featuring comfortable pet beds, food bowls and functional water bowls.[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]All nine colors are available simultaneously through Robin's original building appearance selector, allowing you to choose a different color for each pet bowl on your farm.[/font][/left]

[heading][left][font=Comic Sans MS]Requirements[/font][/left]
[/heading]

[left][b][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley 1.6[/font][/b][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][b]SMAPI[/b][/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://smapi.io/]https://smapi.io/[/url][url=https://smapi.io/][/url][/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][b][b]Content Patcher[/b][/b][/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/url][/font][/left]

[heading][left][font=Comic Sans MS]Installation[/font][/left]
[/heading]

[left][font=Comic Sans MS]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]Download and extract this mod into your Mods folder.[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]Visit Robin's Carpenter Shop and select the Pet Bowl from the construction menu.[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]Use the original appearance arrows to select your preferred color.[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]Build your new pet bowl and enjoy![/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][b][b]No configuration or additional setup is necessary.[/b][/b][/font][/left]

[heading][left][font=Comic Sans MS]Android & Desktop Support[/font][/left]
[/heading]

[left][b][font=Comic Sans MS]The same mod file supports both Windows and Android.[/font][/b][font=Comic Sans MS] No separate platform-specific downloads are required.[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]Tested on Android[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3 (Build 26177)[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]SMAPI 4.3.2.5[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]Content Patcher 2.8.1[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]Tested on Windows[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 (Build 24356)[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]SMAPI 4.5.2[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]Content Patcher 2.9.1[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]No mod-related errors were reported in either platform's SMAPI log[/font][/left]

[heading][left][font=Comic Sans MS]Translations[/font][/left]
[/heading]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]The mod includes an English default localization file and supports community translations through Content Patcher's i18n system.[/font][/left]
[heading][left][font=Comic Sans MS]Credits & Inspiration[/font][/left]
[/heading]

[left][b][font=Comic Sans MS]KhaStark[/font][/b][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]Original hand-drawn food and pet bed artwork, color variants, sprite adaptation, mod development and testing.[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][b][b]ConcernedApe[/b][/b][/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley and the original vanilla pet bowl artwork.[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][b][b]Minakie — Pets' Quality of Life[/b][/b][/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]Visual inspiration for the food bowl design.[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/932]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/932[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/932][/url][/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][b][b]Jeelh — Jeelh's Farm Buildings[/b][/b][/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]Visual inspiration for the pet bed design.[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37726]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37726[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37726][/url][/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][b][b]Pathoschild[/b][/b][/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]All custom food and pet bed artwork was drawn manually by me. The linked mods served solely as visual inspiration. No assets from either mod were copied, modified or redistributed.[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]AI assistance was used for the technical implementation and programmatic spritesheet assembly. No AI-generated artwork was used.[/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][i][i]Special thanks to both creators for inspiring this project.[/i][/i][/font][/left]
[left][/left]

[line]

[left][b][font=Comic Sans MS]I hope you and your pets enjoy this little addition to your farm![/font][/b][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS]If you enjoy the mod, consider leaving an endorsement. Feedback and screenshots of your farms are always welcome![/font][/left]
